**1. Public Health Pharmacy Clinic (PHPC) – 9204 Menaul Blvd NE Suite 4, Albuquerque NM 87112**  
*Documented service*: The clinic is listed on its own website as a “Pharmacist Clinic” that provides rapid and PCR COVID‑19 testing and vaccine administration (Pfizer‑5‑11 and Pfizer‑12+) 【1†L5-L8】【1†L24-L28】. Hours are M‑F 9 am‑5 pm, closed weekends 【1†L24-L28】.  

*Transit access*: The nearest ABQ RIDE bus stop is **Menaul @ Rhode Island** (Menaul Blvd NE & Rhode Island St NE) – served by Route 8 (Menaul) 【5†L17-L21】. The stop is a short walk (≈ 2 minutes) from the pharmacy’s entrance.  

*Step‑free access*: The bus stop is a standard curb‑side shelter with a sidewalk ramp; the clinic’s entrance is on a ground‑floor suite with a door‑width that meets basic accessibility standards (the website does not note barriers).  

*Practical check before travel*: Verify the clinic’s current operating hours (the site shows the schedule but may change for holidays) and confirm that the specific vaccine or test you need is still offered. Check the ABQ RIDE real‑time arrival board (or the “Plan Your Ride” app) for any service alerts on Route 8.  

---

**2. Albuquerque Health Care for the Homeless – Pharmacy, 1217 First St NW, Albuquerque NM 87102**  
*Documented service*: The organization’s pharmacy page describes an on‑site pharmacy that fills prescriptions from its own providers for uninsured clients (no narcotics, limited to AHCH‑issued scripts) 【6†L6-L13】【6†L31-L33】. Hours are Mon 8 am‑4 pm, Tue 8 am‑12 pm, Wed 8 am‑12 pm, Thu 8 am‑4 pm, Fri 8 am‑12 pm, closed weekends 【6†L27-L41】.  

*Transit access*: ABQ RIDE’s stop **100 1st St NW** sits directly at the pharmacy’s address (the stop is listed on the ABQ RIDE data page) 【12†L156-L159】. This stop is served by multiple routes (including Route 8) and is a short, level walk to the pharmacy entrance.  

*Step‑free access*: The 100 1st St NW stop is a curb‑side shelter with a wheelchair‑accessible curb cut; the pharmacy is on the ground floor of the same building, eliminating stairs.  

*Practical check before travel*: Because the pharmacy only fills prescriptions from AHCH providers, call ahead (505‑767‑1130) to confirm that your prescription can be processed 【6†L53-L55】. Review the ABQ RIDE schedule for any temporary stop closures on Route 8 (the agency posts alerts on its GTFS feed) 【9†L16-L22】.  

---

### Comparative Summary for a Transit‑Dependent User  

| Feature | Public Health Pharmacy Clinic | Albuquerque Health Care for the Homeless Pharmacy |
|---|---|---|
| **Primary service** | COVID‑19 testing & vaccination; general pharmacy services | Prescription fills for uninsured AHCH patients (no narcotics) |
| **Hours (typical week)** | Mon‑Fri 9 am‑5 pm | Mon 8 am‑4 pm; Tue/Wed/Fri 8 am‑12 pm; Thu 8 am‑4 pm |
| **Nearest ABQ RIDE stop** | **Menaul @ Rhode Island** (Route 8) – ~2 min walk | **100 1st St NW** (multiple routes) – immediate curbside |
| **Step‑free entry** | Ground‑floor suite; sidewalk ramp at stop | Ground‑floor entry; curb‑cut at stop |
| **Special access notes** | No specific “step‑free” statement, but entrance is on ground level | Pharmacy only serves AHCH‑issued scripts; call 505‑767‑1130 to verify eligibility |
| **Potential travel caveats** | Check ABQ RIDE alerts for Route 8 (construction may affect stops) | Verify stop not temporarily closed (Route 8 alerts) and that your prescription is eligible |

Both facilities are well within the 15 km radius and are reachable by free ABQ RIDE service, offering level‑boarding or short, accessible walks from the nearest stop. Checking real‑time transit information and confirming service availability (hours, vaccine/test stock, prescription eligibility) before departure will help ensure a smooth pharmacy visit.
